topic: Wanting the result without the routine: before setting a goal, look honestly at what it takes every ordinary day (fixed sessions, eating with restraint, training in heat and cold); if we still want it, choose all of it and begin
figure: Epictetus (Enchiridion 29, also Discourses 3.15: you want to win at Olympia? consider what comes before and after it, the regimen, eating by rule, training at a set hour in heat and cold; then, if you still want it, begin). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request
